notes: Phobos Banking lenders (0.2.0; unregistered lenders 0.4.0) (agent choices, 7 October 2026, for the owner to review). Each lends where its home place is, to players who meet its requirements. Repayment follows the game's own mortgage schedule; the lender's interest is billed on the balance at each shift change. Terms are copied into a loan when it is taken, so changing a lender here never changes a loan already running. See docs/bank-player-guide.md and docs/editing-data-files.md.

corvane-mutual.notes: K-Leg's registered lender. Interest about 6.7% of the amount borrowed over a whole loan paid on time (tests/PhobosBank.Tests prints it).
corvane-mutual.name: Corvane Mutual
corvane-mutual.pitch: Corvane Mutual has kept K-Leg crews flying since the yards first turned a profit. Borrow from five thousand up to a quarter of a million, repay by the shift on the same schedule as any station mortgage, and pay a modest interest on what you still owe, with nothing hidden. Ship financing from 35% down. Stay on good terms with OKLGCorp and our door stays open.

halcyon-bond.notes: Mars's registered lender, the cheapest (about 5.4% over a whole loan paid on time), for customers the Xinhua administration already likes.
halcyon-bond.name: Halcyon Bond
halcyon-bond.pitch: Halcyon Bond lends to captains Port Yangshan already trusts. Our rate is the lowest on the ledger, and we finance a ship from 30% down at the Heifei District brokers. Loans from twenty thousand to half a million. We ask one thing first: a warm word from the Xinhua administration.

aerie-savings.notes: Venus's savings union: cash and apartment loans for anyone docked in Venus space (about 8.1% over a whole loan paid on time).
aerie-savings.name: Aerie Savings Union
aerie-savings.pitch: Aerie Savings Union is owned by the people who live up here in the clouds. Anyone docked in Venus space may borrow from five thousand to three hundred thousand, and we will finance an apartment at Porto do Encantado from 40% down. One loan at a time, a fair rate on what you owe, and no questions about who you know.

stillwater-advances.notes: Unregistered quick-money lender at Port Independence, Ganymede (Phobos Banking 0.4.0, agent choice). About 21% interest over a whole loan paid on time.
stillwater-advances.name: Stillwater Advances
stillwater-advances.pitch: Need it today? Stillwater Advances does not keep you waiting while a committee reads your file. Two thousand to sixty thousand, paid across before your coffee cools, and ships financed from a quarter down. Our rate is higher than the registered houses and we say so plainly. Miss a shift and the ledger adds its fee, same as anyone's.

narrow-ledger.notes: Unregistered lender at the counter in Corsair's Hollow, Ceres; lends only to a player docked there (Phobos Banking 0.4.0, agent choice). About 40% interest over a whole loan paid on time.
narrow-ledger.name: The Narrow Ledger
narrow-ledger.pitch: No standing, no references, no questions about where the last ship went. The Narrow Ledger lends small and lends fast to anyone who finds the counter. Our terms are steep because nobody else will have you, and we both know it. Pay by the shift and we stay friends.

orrery-credit.notes: System-wide credit line (Phobos Banking 0.6.0; owner choices, 7 October 2026: a new service, opened from anywhere, one revolving balance, a draw fee plus a higher rate). Terms are agent choices for the owner to review: dearer than every lender at its counter, Stillwater Advances included, and cheaper than the Narrow Ledger. The rate rose from 0.06% to 0.10% a shift in Phobos Banking 0.8.1 (owner decision, 8 October 2026), because 0.06% undercut Stillwater. Lore is ChatGPT's to write (docs/development/banking-stories-handoff.md).
orrery-credit.name: Orrery Credit
orrery-credit.pitch: Wherever your course takes you, Orrery Credit goes with it. Open a line from your PDA, draw when you need to, and pay it back by the shift. It costs more than walking into a lender's office, and we say so up front: a small fee on every draw and a higher rate on what you owe. You pay nothing until you draw.
